mode: shadow (offline; never shown on the site)

rules.shadow_projection: Phase 2 final fit (knobs + linear calibration) for stats with recommendation=candidate; otherwise the current projection is carried (carried_current=true)
rules.current_projection: pre-promotion formula when the slate row has formula_applied and baseline_projection (the site projection is then published_projection); otherwise the slate projection
rules.shadow_side: candidate stats: sign(shadow_projection - line); carried stats: current pick
rules.p_over: Phase 2 logistic on (fit_projection - line, line); standard lines only
rules.top_bucket: top 20% of the day's standard lines by |projection - line| / stat walk-forward MAE, separately for current and shadow
rules.leakage: inputs pinned per prop at its pregame ref (source_commit, or last commit before a provably pregame legacy freeze); game logs filtered to dates before the game date
